concerns.text: FR-001 specifies that the `delta` entry must contain a `direction` flag expressed as (+/‑). However, SC-001 requires the `direction` field to be the string values “increase” or “decrease”. This creates a contradictory representation requirement for the same output field.

FR-014 allows the bootstrap iteration count to fall back to 500 when dataset size > 5 000, but SC-004 mandates that at least 1 000 bootstrap iterations be performed for each cleaned variant. The fallback rule directly violates the success‑criterion minimum.
